subject.title: fix(android): keep composer media with its chat

question: Should Android upgrades intentionally park legacy outbox rows with no provable agent owner for manual re-entry or deletion instead of attempting automatic replay?
rationale: Either behavior is technically implementable, but it chooses between message-recovery convenience and the risk of replaying a persisted message into the wrong agent or chat; repository policy requires explicit acceptance for this schema and fallback decision.

options.title: Approve fail-safe recovery
options.body: Keep ambiguous legacy rows visible but non-retryable, require exact-head migration proof, and document the one-time manual recovery behavior.

options.title: Preserve automatic replay
options.body: Redesign the migration to derive a trustworthy historical owner or preserve replay only where ownership can be proven, with upgrade tests for every retained path.

recommendation.title: Approve fail-safe recovery
recommendation.body: Keep ambiguous legacy rows visible but non-retryable, require exact-head migration proof, and document the one-time manual recovery behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the repository-listed Android subsystem owner and are the best available decision owner for Android upgrade and recovery UX.
